mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file ( tenant_id, file_name, file_path, url, storage_type, file_size, file_type, file_hash, access_type, create_by, create_time, deleted, remark ) VALUES ( #{r.tenantId}, #{r.fileName}, #{r.filePath}, #{r.url}, 'LOCAL', #{r.fileSize}, #{r.fileType}, #{r.fileHash}, 'PRIVATE', #{r.createBy}, NOW(), 0, 'hr-pdf' )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, file_name AS fileName, file_type AS fileType FROM sys_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_by = #{owner} AND deleted = 0 AND file_id IN #{fileId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_by = #{owner} AND deleted = 0 AND file_type = 'HR_LEAVE_PROOF' AND file_id IN #{fileId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_by = #{owner} AND deleted = 0 AND file_type = 'HR_GRIEVANCE' AND file_id IN #{fileId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_by = #{owner} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND file_type = #{purpose} AND deleted = 0
